recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-24091 unless maintainers separately want to remove the legacy empty anchor as editorial housekeeping.
issue_request: FHIR-24091 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for R5 asking that Medication section 11.5.4, "Best practices for using 'Medication'," be removed because Medication.status had been added.
initial_application: Commit 48438a7205421769bebb35c255e22d24aaa57251 removed the Best Practice heading and paragraph from source/medication/medication-notes.xml, including the obsolete statement that Medication did not have a status and the formulary-status extension guidance. The current source and the combined branch no longer contain that text.
additional_context: Medication is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, so source/medication is in current build scope. The current Medication StructureDefinition includes Medication.status, and its comment clarifies that this status is for local drug database or inventory use rather than formulary membership. Pharmacy Confluence minutes for 2020-01-06 record FHIR-24091 as approved and point back to Jira. The historical implementation commit also mentioned FHIR-25230, but that issue concerns MedicationKnowledge.patientCharacteristic and is separate from this Medication narrative cleanup.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change was needed because the obsolete implementer-facing Best Practice prose is absent from current source; only a harmless legacy bp anchor remains.

related_jiras.note: Co-mentioned in the historical implementation commit, but it concerns MedicationKnowledge.patientCharacteristic and was not decided here.
